notes.title: Devlog 3 – What We Did Last Week + 300 Wishlists!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We’re back with another exciting devlog, and this week we have a special milestone to celebrate: we’ve reached 300 wishlists! 🎉 We were planning to do a post for 200 wishlists, but before we even realized it, we hit 300! A massive thank you to everyone who’s supported us. We couldn’t have done it without you! 🚀

Now, let’s dive into what we’ve been working on this past week:

1. More Classic Minigames for the Arcade
We’ve added more classic minigames for you to enjoy in the arcade! From retro-inspired challenges to exciting new activities, there’s plenty to keep you entertained as you explore Sierra.

2. Texturing the Arcade
We’ve been hard at work texturing the arcade interior. It’s starting to come together with vibrant colours and an immersive feel that’ll make every visit to the arcade an experience to remember!

3. Remodeling the Characters
We’ve started remodelling the characters to give them a better finish and more charisma. Our goal is to make them even more expressive and engaging, so they’ll feel alive as you interact with them in the game.

That’s it for this week! As always, thank you for being part of this journey, and don’t forget to follow our page and join our Discord for more in-depth updates and discussions.

See you next week! 👋

notes.title: Devlog 2 – What We Did Last Week!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We’re a little late with this week’s devlog, but that’s because we had some important meetings at the end of the week to discuss the exciting future of Neighbors! We’re thrilled about what’s coming, but let’s get into what we accomplished last week:

1. New Arcade Game: Pinball!
We’ve added a new classic game to the arcade: Pinball! 🕹️ Get ready to rack up high scores and earn tickets for special rewards.

2. Arcanoid Interior Models Complete
We’ve completed the models for the interior of the Arcanoid and are now working on texturing them. Soon, you’ll be able to enjoy this immersive space as you explore all the games it has to offer.

3. Rewards in the Arcade
We’ve started working on the reward system for the arcade. You’ll be able to trade tickets from games like Air Hockey and Pinball for exclusive, one-of-a-kind items!

4. Male Character Model
We’ve implemented the base model for male characters in the game! Our next steps are refining details and integrating them into the customization system smoothly.

That’s all for this week’s update! Don’t forget to follow our page and join our Discord to stay up to date with more in-depth discussions and get the latest news. Exciting things are coming soon—stay tuned! 👀
